title: Bounded notification live updates

behavior.tenantRoleGuard: The SSE endpoint is mounted under the existing tenant guard and notification role matrix. Elevated roles receive the workspace scope; other allowed roles receive their own and broadcast notifications.
behavior.snapshotOnly: Each notification event contains only a latest-record cursor, total count and unread count. The stream never sends notification bodies, links, private object keys or record payloads.
behavior.boundedConnection: The server checks the existing muted/user/broadcast scope every two seconds and closes a stream after 60 seconds.
behavior.browserFallback: The browser refetches the existing guarded notification list after a changed snapshot and retains the existing 60-second polling fallback when EventSource is unavailable or fails.
behavior.preserved: Existing notification producers, read/unread actions, category muting, explicit preference saves, migrations and tenant/revision/security checks remain unchanged.

localVerification.sseIntegrationCoverage: Added tenant-bound initial/change snapshot and cross-tenant denial assertions.
localVerification.httpBrowserHarness: Not claimed locally; the owned verifier stopped before fixture startup because 127.0.0.1:1025 (Mailpit) was already occupied and the harness fails closed.

exactCi.requires: All three jobs and every required step on the exact published NOTIFY-01G commit, followed by a fresh portable source ZIP and external receipt.

limits: This increment is an in-app SSE transport only; it does not add email, SMS, mobile push, cross-process fan-out, durable replay or a delivery SLO.
CI verifies owned fixtures and does not deploy.
Production/live-provider, remote durability/RPO-RTO, deployed and full-master acceptance remain open.
